samplePolicy.percentiles: nearest-rank; with five samples p95 is the maximum, not a robust tail estimate
samplePolicy.normalRuns: No CPU/heap profiler and measurePhases disabled. One unmeasured JIT warm-up precedes hot-engine samples; pipeline samples follow hot runs.
samplePolicy.io: Buffered filesystem I/O, no fsync and no OS page-cache purge. End-to-end starts at CSV import and ends after atomic result publication; fixture creation and module startup are excluded.
samplePolicy.rss: Each case is a separate process. Linux resourceUsage.maxRSS supplies the process high-water mark; parent /proc VmRSS is additionally sampled every 20 ms. Both include dataset preparation and all case phases.
samplePolicy.gc: PerformanceObserver records are drained outside timed intervals; only events starting inside each interval are counted. Sweeps have separate worker isolates whose GC is not included.
samplePolicy.concurrency: Scenarios run serially; each multiworker sweep uses four workers. This is a shared development machine, not a reserved benchmark host.
